crossRefs.note: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
“Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and…
‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
“The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the…
In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have…
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to…
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in…
“ ‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.
Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days.…
“Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
“Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me…
For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,
“If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the Sabbath a delight…
Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who…
You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

translations.web: “ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.
